description:
Meet the BULLS Cross Lite S – a sleek and powerful Class-3 (28mph) eBike made for fast-paced commutes and extended adventures. With its Bosch smart tech, integrated battery, and comfort-forward design, this bike is your everyday companion for city cruising or weekend getaways.

Motor and Battery

Motor: Bosch Performance Line Speed Smart System, 85 Nm of torque, pedal assist up to 28 mph – smooth, quiet, and punchy power when you need it.

Battery: Bosch PowerTube 750Wh – seamlessly integrated into the frame for clean lines and long-range capability.

Charging: Bosch 4A charger – full charge in approx. 6 hours for reliable daily riding.

Suspension and Frame

Fork: Suntour MOBIE34 2CR-PCS DS, 100 mm travel – plush suspension for city bumps and light trail detours.

Frame: Lightweight aluminum 6061 with internal cable routing. Sizes: 45 cm (S), 50 cm (M), 55 cm (L).

Drivetrain and Brakes

Gearing: Shimano Deore 10-speed drivetrain (RD-M5120SGS), with Shimano CS-M4100-10 (11-46T) cassette – smooth shifting and great climbing range.

Crankset: Samox EP01A-BHV04-DG-C50, 170mm, 48T – efficient pedaling on every terrain.

Brakes: Shimano BR-MT200 hydraulic disc brakes with 203mm front and 180mm rear rotors – powerful, consistent braking rain or shine.

Wheels and Tires

Wheels: Durable BULLS 700C double-wall rims – strong, stable, and made for the miles.

Tires: CST C-3031 700x50C – wide, grippy tires for smooth rolling and added confidence on city streets or gravel paths.

Additional Features

Display: Bosch Kiox 300 with LED Remote – bright, compact, and fully connected.

Handlebar: BULLS alloy, 680mm width, 28mm rise, 25° sweep – ergonomic and responsive.

Stem: Adjustable (70mm on 45/50cm, 90mm on 55cm) for dialed-in comfort.

Seatpost and Saddle: 31.6mm post with 7mm offset, 2-bolt head; paired with Selle Royal Essenza Plus saddle – built for comfort, mile after mile.

Pedals: Wellgo C-098DU anti-slip – steady footing every time.

Technology and Design

Smart System: Bosch eBike Flow app ready – customize ride modes, track performance, get updates wirelessly.

Class: Class-3 eBike – up to 28 mph pedal assist for fast, legal commuting where permitted.

Key Takeaways

The Cross Lite S blends sporty performance with commuter practicality – it’s fast, comfortable, and built to last. Whether you’re riding to work or riding into the weekend, it’s ready when you are.
